summary: Round 1 repeatable regression rerun passed with exit code 0. Deterministic engine passed 35/35 (30 single-Gate + 5 multi-Gate), browser journeys passed 10/10 with screenshots, and controlled-mode labelling remained explicit/non-live. Targeted frontend regressions and backend Ask handoff tests passed.

ui_bugs.issue: No reliable initial testID was detectable in first-load state during smoke check; automation had to infer load from rendered content/screenshot.

action_items: Optional: add a stable initial-screen testID for onboarding entry state to improve first-load automation reliability.
Optional: reduce Node test warning noise by declaring module type strategy for frontend test/runtime files.
critical_code_review_comments: Repeatable-mode controls are clearly labelled in output (controlled 503 external fixtures + controlled Higgins SSE) and are not represented as live.

Round 1 runner currently defaults base URL in code when env is absent; acceptable for this permanent command use-case but note this differs from strict fail-fast env-only backend/frontend runtime policy.

Live-mode component compatibility requirement (fallback and live MessageAssessmentResult for Text/Email/App) is implemented in runner selectors via wait_for_any combinations and validated in this repeatable rerun path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repeatable command now reproduces full 10/10 browser journeys (prior stale report had 1/1 only). Artifacts refreshed under /app/test_reports/round1_artifacts/repeatable. Device-only list remains separate and Stage 1D remains cancelled.
rca_of_issue: Smoke selector miss occurred because app loaded into onboarding state where expected home/gates testIDs were not present; screenshot confirmed app loaded successfully. This is a testability gap (missing stable initial testID), not a functional outage.
